title: Crypt Lord Ring
summary: Raise a Small or Medium corpse as a mummy once per Long Rest.

fields.Create Undead: Action once per Long Rest. Target a Small or Medium corpse within 10 ft. The mummy stays until Long Rest and disappears if you unequip the ring.
fields.Acquisition: Reward for finding Mystic Carrion’s servant when Thrumbo survives.
fields.Mummy: AC 18 and 93 HP on Balanced. Uses Dreadful Glare to Frighten and Multiattack against Frightened targets. Rotting Fist is its melee attack.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details and pinned item and rules evidence. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
